The NAICS code is 334516, and the small business size standard is 1000 employees. This acquisition is being conducted in accordance with the procedures of FAR Part 12 and FAR Part 13. The National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases requires the acquisition of insect cell shakers for the Laboratory of Molecular Biology. These systems are used to support insect cell culture processes for biomolecular research and protein production activities. Required features of this purchase: The system shall accommodate up to six 3-liter flasks or three 5-liter flasks. The system shall provide a shaking throw of 50 millimeters and a speed range of 20 to 350 revolutions per minute, with 1 revolution per minute increments and accuracy of plus or minus 1 percent. The system shall provide a temperature range of 4 degrees Celsius to 65 degrees Celsius, with 0.1 degree Celsius increments and temperature deviation of plus or minus 0.8 degrees Celsius. The system shall include cooling capability to achieve temperatures at least 16 degrees Celsius below ambient conditions. The system shall include an N-style tray with a non-slip surface to support flask stability without the use of clamps. The system shall have a maximum footprint of 800 x 625 x 700 millimeters. The system shall be floor-standing. The system shall utilize a magnetic drive system with a brushless three-phase motor to minimize vibration and wear. The system shall include a front-opening design with a pull-out tray to allow for loading and unloading of flasks.
